Please solve this issue: Deleting a book is supposed to leave a permanent record of who had access to
it at that moment: the `Book` model writes one row per person into the
`access_archives` table (`AccessArchive`), so an administrator can later see
who lost what. It has never worked — the archive always comes out empty, no
matter how many people the book was shared with. Deletion itself is fine: the
book and its access grants are removed as expected.

Fix it so that deleting a book through the app writes exactly one archive row
for every person who had access at the moment of deletion, recording the user
and their access level (reader or editor) as it stood. Nothing may be written
before the deletion happens, and someone whose access was revoked earlier must
not appear.

A book nobody had access to gets no rows at all, and that holds however such a
book ends up deleted — even directly from the console. The book and its access
grants still go, exactly as today.

class BookTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "slug is generated from title" do
    book = Book.create!(title: "Hello, World!")
    assert_equal "hello-world", book.slug
  end

    assert_equal "Important words", leaf.page.body.content.to_s
    assert_equal "Introduction", leaf.title
  end

  test "markable combines all leafables" do
    leaves(:welcome_page).leafable.update!(body: "Welcome page content")
    leaves(:summary_page).leafable.update!(body: "Summary page content")

    assert_includes books(:handbook).markable, "Welcome page content"
    assert_includes books(:handbook).markable, "Summary page content"
  end

  test "markable joins leafables with double newlines" do
    leaves(:welcome_page).leafable.update!(body: "Welcome content")
    leaves(:summary_page).leafable.update!(body: "Summary content")

    assert_includes books(:handbook).markable, "Welcome content\n\nSummary content"
  end

  test "markable only includes active leaves" do
    leaves(:welcome_page).leafable.update!(body: "Active content")
    leaves(:summary_page).trashed!

    assert_includes books(:handbook).markable, "Active content"
    assert_not_includes books(:handbook).markable, leaves(:summary_page).title
  end

  test "markable returns empty string for book with no leaves" do
    assert_equal "", books(:manual).markable
  end

  test "destroying a book archives each user's access level" do
    book = books(:handbook)
    assert_empty AccessArchive.where(book_id: book.id)

    book.destroy

    assert_not Book.exists?(book.id)
    assert_empty Access.where(book_id: book.id)

    archives = AccessArchive.where(book_id: book.id)
    assert_equal 4, archives.count
    assert_equal [ "Handbook" ], archives.pluck(:book_title).uniq

    expected = {
      users(:david).id => [ users(:david).name, "editor" ],
      users(:jason).id => [ users(:jason).name, "editor" ],
      users(:jz).id => [ users(:jz).name, "reader" ],
      users(:kevin).id => [ users(:kevin).name, "editor" ]
    }
    actual = archives.each_with_object({}) { |row, map| map[row.user_id] = [ row.user_name, row.level ] }
    assert_equal expected, actual
  end

  test "destroying a book omits revoked accesses and records updated levels" do
    book = books(:handbook)
    book.update!(everyone_access: false)
    book.update_access(editors: [ users(:david).id ], readers: [ users(:kevin).id ])

    assert_empty AccessArchive.where(book_id: book.id)

    book.destroy

    archives = AccessArchive.where(book_id: book.id)
    expected = {
      users(:david).id => [ users(:david).name, "editor" ],
      users(:kevin).id => [ users(:kevin).name, "reader" ]
    }
    actual = archives.each_with_object({}) { |row, map| map[row.user_id] = [ row.user_name, row.level ] }
    assert_equal expected, actual
  end

  test "destroying a book with no accesses creates no archive rows" do
    unshared_book = Book.create!(title: "Unshared Book", everyone_access: false)
    orphan_book = Book.create!(title: "Orphan Book", everyone_access: true)

    assert_no_difference -> { AccessArchive.count } do
      unshared_book.destroy
      orphan_book.destroy
    end

    assert_not Book.exists?(unshared_book.id)
    assert_not Book.exists?(orphan_book.id)
  end

    assert_not_includes archived_user_ids, users(:jz).id
    assert_equal 3, archived_user_ids.size
  end
